lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in semi-regular horizontal rows across the mid-flank, with spacing increasing toward the posterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows, forming a visible grid-like coordinate system on the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal aspect and deep shadow on the ventral aspect.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of small, high-chroma yellow objects (likely symbiotic fish) positioned near the anterior cephalic region and the pectoral fin base.
